model: dynamic grad(s), periodic, synchronous normalized H, no div(v)
primary: generator changes under B frozen observer; independently retuned observer secondary
proxy: 4 units x 2 rotations x clean/1% + train reference per dimension
loss: unit mean relative absolute geometry + .05*unit mean angle/90; also record weights0,.2
observer: separate geometry MARE and orientation angle only, DE120 each head/N, train reference coefficient
selection: validation Pareto geometry/angle/single-pass component latency in warmed process; fastest within .25 percentage points best geometry and .25deg best angle; else geometry and orientation priority separately
test_policy: fresh grouped prototypes, freeze before single test, no test retuning
exclusions: No reconstruction/topology/residual/width loss, candidate rejection, selection or fallback
extension: G3 only if validation fixed-observer G2 improvement; not automatically expanded
cost_sensitivity: equal eval primary; common measured-walltime prefix, not separate equal-time optimizer
spacing: generated gradient divided by physical a; observer physical derivatives and quadrature equivalent factor a^(d-2) with train reference calibration
limitations: finite-budget local/random search, no global optimum certificate
comparisons: fixed B observer comparisons at B-selected N, coefficient frozen and separately train-only recalibrated; per-arm retuned N reported separately
